jobs.title: (Senior) Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 


THE ROLE

As a Product Marketer, you will develop the positioning, narratives and materials that make Helsing's products clear and credible to customers, partners and decision-makers. This asks for a thorough understanding of our technology across both hardware and software, and the craft to translate it. Your work will directly inform how governments and defence customers understand Helsing.


THE DAY-TO-DAY

 - Develop and maintain core marketing materials — positioning statements, one-pagers, messaging frameworks and sales enablement kits
   
   

 - Embed yourself with our Product, Programmes and Campaigns teams to turn technology capabilities into product narratives that land with each audience
   
   

 - Collaborate closely with Communications, Events and Content teams to develop authentic product stories
   
   

 - Lead go-to-market for new capabilities and product updates, including sequencing, messaging, moments and materials
   
   

 - Conduct market and competitive analysis to identify differentiation, emerging trends and new opportunities


YOU SHOULD APPLY IF YOU

 - Have delivered product marketing in a technology environment — including owning a launch end-to-end, with the artefacts and outcomes to show for it
   
   

 - Can translate complex or technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives without losing accuracy or substance — and have writing samples that demonstrate this
   
   

 - Have moved into an unfamiliar technology or product area and got up to speed quickly, without needing close supervision
   
   

 - Have built trust with cross-functional teams — product, engineering and customer-facing
   
   

 - Are fluent in English and German, written and spoken
   
   

 - Are motivated by Helsing's mission to protect democratic societies, and ready to engage with the responsibility that comes with it


NICE TO HAVE 

 - Familiarity with the defence, aerospace, robotics or government sectors
   
   

 - Willingness and ability to travel periodically to our European offices

Note: This position may require the successful applicant to apply for and be granted security clearance.


JOIN HELSING AND WORK WITH WORLD-LEADING EXPERTS IN THEIR FIELDS

 - Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.

 - The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital.

 - Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward.

 - In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts. 

 - We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individuals are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - A focus on outcomes, not time-tracking

 - Competitive compensation and VSOP options

 - Relocation support

 - Social and education allowances

 - Regular company events and all-hands to bring together employees as one team across Europe

#LI-DNI

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

THE ROLE

Electronic warfare is one of the most technically demanding and operationally consequential domains in modern defence — and it is one where Helsing intends to make a real difference. As Product Manager for Electronic Warfare, you will lead product work across offboard and cross-platform EW capabilities: from problem framing and discovery, through requirements definition and roadmap, to release and iteration in production. You will work directly with EW operators, analysts, and mission planners in their environments, translating complex and often ambiguous operational inputs into precise product requirements. Embedded within a cross-functional team spanning RF hardware, embedded software, machine learning, and ground-side tooling, you will ensure that trade-offs are surfaced clearly, decisions are made with confidence, and a consistent shipping cadence is maintained — even in security-constrained and data-scarce conditions. This role can be based out of either Munich or Berlin, with regular travel to customer sites across Europe.

Own the product scope for offboard and cross-platform EW capabilities — leading problem framing, discovery, requirements, roadmap, and release across the full product lifecycle

 - Engage directly with EW operators, analysts, and mission planners in their working environments, converting operationally complex and often second-hand inputs into clear, actionable product specifications
   
   

 - Define and continuously improve the workflows by which customers adapt Helsing's products to their own data environments and operational contexts under security and data-availability constraints
   
   

 - Drive the end-to-end process by which mission-critical data products are built, validated, and rolled out across teams and platforms — maintaining rigour at every stage
   
   

 - Determine how Helsing's products integrate with customers' existing data sources, intelligence systems, and mission planning tools, ensuring operational coherence at the point of use
   
   

 - Facilitate clear decision-making across a cross-functional team spanning RF, embedded software, ML, and ground-side tooling — making trade-offs visible and ensuring they are resolved with appropriate urgency
   
   

 - Establish and maintain a regular, reliable shipping cadence into production environments where the conditions for frequent deployment are difficult by default

 - Have worked directly with end users in mission-critical or operational settings, translating ambiguous, real-world needs into precise and implementable product requirements
   
   

 - Have successfully integrated products into existing customer data sources, intelligence systems, and operational toolchains — and maintained a consistent production shipping cadence in constrained
   environments

 - Engage substantively with engineering teams spanning RF hardware, embedded software, and machine learning — bringing enough technical fluency to make trade-offs legible and decisions well-founded
   
   

 - Hold a degree in electrical engineering, physics, computer science, or a related STEM discipline
   
   

 - Hold a valid work permit for Germany, are eligible to undergo a German government security clearance at SÜ2 level, and have professional proficiency in English alongside working proficiency in German (B1 or above)


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building products for defence, government, or other mission-critical customers, particularly in data-scarce or security-constrained environments
   
   

 - A background in radar, RF, or electronic warfare — whether academic, industrial, or operational (for example, as an EW operator, SIGINT analyst, or radar/EW engineer)

WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary and VSOP options

 - Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation

 - Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance

 - Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)

 - Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances

 - Partner with engineering and design: Work day-to-day with engineers and UX designers to shape intuitive, high-tempo interfaces for supervising autonomous behavior, managing mission state, and maintaining operator situational awareness.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE


 

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.


 


 

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

THE ROLE


 

As Product Manager (Air) – Perception & Sensor Fusion, you will define what our uncrewed combat aerial vehicle sees, understands and shares. You will own the product vision and roadmap for the full perception software stack, spanning electro-optical and electromagnetic sensor processing, data fusion from single sensors to collaborative multi-aircraft operations, the common operating picture, and perception-based navigation in GNSS-denied environments. Working with operational users, software and AI engineers, systems engineers and flight test teams, you will translate demanding mission needs into clear requirements, measurable performance targets and a prioritised roadmap, and you will see your decisions travel from whiteboard to flight test. By giving aircraft and operators a reliable, trustworthy picture of the battlespace, you will shape a core capability of a next-generation European uncrewed combat aircraft and directly strengthen the ability of European armed forces to deter and defend, with humans firmly in control.


 

 


 


THE DAY-TO-DAY


 

 - Own the product strategy and roadmap for airborne perception, covering EO/IR and RF sensor processing, multi-level data fusion, situational awareness and perception-aided navigation, so that every release maps to a defined operational capability

 - Shape the perception data strategy with data and ML infrastructure teams, including collection campaigns, simulation and synthetic data needs

 - Have taken a complex capability from requirements through integration and test into the field or into flight
